easy.def: The person in front who shows the way.
examples: Today I am the line leader.
The leader of the band waved a stick.

more.def: A person who guides or is in charge of a group.
examples: A good leader listens to everyone on the team.
The team chose her as leader because she is fair.
The scout leader showed us how to build a fire.

easy.def: A very old story that people still tell.
examples: There is a legend about a dragon in this cave.
The legend is about a brave girl.

more.def: An old story passed down over many years that may or may not be true.
examples: According to legend, a giant made these hills.
The legend says a monster lives in the lake.
Many legends are told about the brave king.
